title: Korkie Kryze
description: Cadet Korkie Kryze was the nephew of the Duchess of Mandalore and a student at the Royal Academy of Government on Mandalore. There, he spent his days learning to become a leader of the planet. Insightful, ambitious, and intelligent, Korkie was a faithful ally of his aunt. She helped him overcome the corruption plaguing the planet and was later instrumental in fighting back against Maul's invading force, the Shadow Collective.
